header.title: Neurodiversity in Work Life
header.quote: Difference is not a bug. It is a feature.
header.intro: This page is made for everyone whose brain works differently – and for their supervisors.

superpowers.title: Resources
superpowers.subtitle: Why do we need this?
superpowers.productivity: Efficiency: Hyperfocus can produce a week's work in a day.

spoon_theory.title: Spoon Theory
spoon_theory.text: Imagine you only have 12 spoons of energy for a day. For a neurotypical, a shower costs nothing. For a neurodivergent, it might cost one spoon. Open office noise might cost five.

what.title: What are spoons?
what.text: Units of mental and physical energy.

environment.title: Environment
environment.text: Open offices, bright lights, and constant interruptions are poison.

misunderstandings.title: Misunderstandings
misunderstandings.text: Direct speech can be interpreted as rudeness. Silence as indifference.

masking.title: Masking
masking.text: Masking is hiding neuroatypical traits to fit in. It is heavy and leads to burnout. Looking 'normal' is a full-time job.

employee.title: For Employee
list: Identify your needs: What things take spoons?
Communicate: Use the 'User Manual for Me' template.
Protect focus: Reserve uninterrupted time in the calendar.

manager.title: For Supervisor
list: Allow flexibility: Remote work, working hours, communication methods.

decoder.title: Double Empathy
decoder.intro: Often the problem is not 'autistic interaction', but the incompatibility of two different systems. This interpreter helps.

items.nt: Eye contact means you are listening.
items.nd: If I look in the eyes, I don't hear what you say because I process your face.
Why do we talk about obvious things? I would like to talk about strategy.

logs.title: Documentation Templates
logs.subtitle: When you need something concrete for occupational health or discussions.

accommodation.title: Accommodation Request
accommodation.desc: Use this when asking for flexibility.
accommodation.content: Hi, to work most effectively, I would need the following accommodation: [ACCOMMODATION]. This would help me [BENEFIT]. For example, last week...

breakdown.title: Load Log
breakdown.desc: Track your alertness and meltdown risk.
breakdown.content: Date: [DATE] | Spoons in morning: [1-5] | Most loading moment: [EVENT] | Symptoms: [SENSORY OVERSENSITIVITY/SHUTDOWN] | Recovery: [METHOD]

rights.title: Did you know?
rights.text: The Non-Discrimination Act obliges the employer to make reasonable accommodations for neurodiversity. You are not asking for 'extra', but equality.

simulation.title: Simulations
simulation.text: Theory is one thing. Experience is another. Step into ND shoes.
